prompt: Run a quick, read-only repository audit on the small snapshot in subject/. There are no independent workers, web access, Git metadata or shell execution. Write scope.md and report.md in the working directory outside subject/. Disclose any blocked checks or generation instead of claiming to have run them. Do not edit the subject, record owner decisions, or look elsewhere for more evidence.
terse: Record the audit scope, then inspect the snapshot and report actionable findings. Mark verification as single-context and record independent external checks as not run. Distinguish observed findings from blocked checks.
